description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Complaint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Reimbursement"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer satisfaction feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organization" name="Organization" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="File complaint"
                      sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_Complaint"
                      messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApprovedDecision" name="Notify approved decision"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyApproved" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"
                      messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RejectedDecision" name="Notify rejected decision"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyRejected" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"
                      messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Provide reimbursement"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund"
                      messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provide satisfaction feedback"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Participant_Organization"
                      messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Determine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Financial" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogAssign" name="Log complaint and assign it to the relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Determine" name="Determine complaint validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyApproved" name="Notify customer of the decision approving a refund"
                   messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyRejected" name="Notify customer of the decision rejecting a refund"
                   messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundMerge" name="Merge refund outcomes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complaint" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToLog" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogAssign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogToReview" sourceRef="Task_LogAssign" targetRef="Task_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDetermine" sourceRef="Task_Review" targetRef="Task_Determine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineToDecision" sourceRef="Task_Determine" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyApproved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyApprovedToRefund" sourceRef="Task_NotifyApproved" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyRejectedToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRejected" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToResolved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolvedToEnd" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="File complaint and provide feedback" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive complaint decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefund" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_CustomerRejected"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRefund" name="Receive reimbursement" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" name="Provide satisfaction feedback?" default="Flow_NoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide satisfaction feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Customer interaction complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartToFile" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FileToDecision" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionToCustomerGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerRejected" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundReceivedToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">feedbackProvided = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
